summary_1line: Dhritarashtra questions Arjuna’s assault and Drona’s fall as Sanjaya recounts Duryodhana organizing defenses around Drona during a fierce night battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna with white steeds drives into the Kaurava host at night, his arrows blazing like a raging conflagration among clustered chariots.
Duryodhana stands in the dark battlefield directing warriors to guard Drona’s chariot from every side while torches flicker over armored troops.
In the dead of night, elephants, horses, and chariots collide amid showers of arrows, the battlefield roaring with chaos under a black sky.
